name: Allah (CC)
meaning: The One God, unique and free from all imperfections.

name: Ar-Rahman
meaning: The One who shows mercy and compassion to all creatures in the world.

name: Ar-Rahim
meaning: The One who shows mercy only to believers in the Hereafter.

name: Al-Malik
meaning: The Owner of the universe, whose dominion and sovereignty are eternal.

name: Al-Quddus
meaning: The One free from all imperfections and worthy of all praise.

name: As-Salam
meaning: The One who delivers from all kinds of dangers.

name: Al-Mu'min
meaning: The One who gives security and protection.

name: Al-Muhaymin
meaning: The One who watches over everything and is aware of everything.

name: Al-Aziz
meaning: The Possessor of Might, the Victorious over all, the Irresistible.

name: Al-Jabbar
meaning: The Possessor of Majesty and Power. The One who compels His will.

name: Al-Mutakabbir
meaning: The One who has no equal in greatness.

name: Al-Khaliq
meaning: The Creator, the One who creates from nothing.

name: Al-Bari
meaning: The One who creates everything perfectly and harmoniously.

name: Al-Musawwir
meaning: The One who gives shape to creatures and creates them in different forms.

name: Al-Ghaffar
meaning: The One who covers sins and forgives much.

name: Al-Qahhar
meaning: The Dominant One who prevails over everything to do whatever He wills.

name: Al-Wahhab
meaning: The One who gives freely without expecting anything in return.

name: Ar-Razzaq
meaning: The One who provides sustenance to all creatures.

name: Al-Fattah
meaning: The Opener of gates and the Solver of difficulties.

name: Al-Alim
meaning: The All-Knowing of everything, hidden or open, past or future.

name: Al-Qabid
meaning: The One who constricts and tightens sustenance as He wills.

name: Al-Basit
meaning: The One who expands and gives abundance as He wills.

name: Al-Khafid
meaning: The One who lowers ranks and humiliates the disbelievers.

name: Ar-Rafi
meaning: The One who elevates and gives honor.

name: Al-Mu'izz
meaning: The One who gives honor and dignity to whom He wills.

name: Al-Mudhill
meaning: The One who humiliates and abases whom He wills.

name: As-Sami
meaning: The All-Hearing of everything.

name: Al-Basir
meaning: The All-Seeing of everything, hidden or open.

name: Al-Hakam
meaning: The Absolute Judge who separates truth from falsehood.

name: Al-Adl
meaning: The Absolute Just, the One of infinite justice.

name: Al-Latif
meaning: The Subtle One who knows all subtleties and is kind.

name: Al-Khabir
meaning: The One who is aware of everything that has happened or will happen.

name: Al-Halim
meaning: The Forbearing One who does not hurry to punish.

name: Al-Azim
meaning: The Magnificent One whose greatness has no parallel.

name: Al-Ghafur
meaning: The One whose forgiveness is abundant.

name: Ash-Shakur
meaning: The One who gives great reward for little deeds.

name: Al-Aliyy
meaning: The Most High, the Exalted.

name: Al-Kabir
meaning: The Greatest, whose greatness has no parallel.

name: Al-Hafiz
meaning: The Preserver of everything.

name: Al-Muqit
meaning: The Nourisher who gives sustenance to every creature.

name: Al-Hasib
meaning: The One who takes the best account of servants.

name: Al-Jalil
meaning: The Possessor of Majesty and Grandeur.

name: Al-Karim
meaning: The Generous One whose bounty is abundant.

name: Ar-Raqib
meaning: The Watchful One who observes every being and action.

name: Al-Mujib
meaning: The Responder to prayers and requests.

name: Al-Wasi
meaning: The All-Encompassing with His mercy and knowledge.

name: Al-Hakim
meaning: The Wise One who does everything with wisdom.

name: Al-Wadud
meaning: The Loving One who loves His servants most.

name: Al-Majid
meaning: The Glorious One worthy of all praise.

name: Al-Ba'ith
meaning: The Resurrecter of the dead.

name: Ash-Shahid
meaning: The Witness who is present everywhere at all times.

name: Al-Haqq
meaning: The Truth whose existence never changes.

name: Al-Wakil
meaning: The Trustee who manages the affairs of those who rely on Him.

name: Al-Qawiyy
meaning: The Possessor of All Strength.

name: Al-Matin
meaning: The Firm One, the source of strength and power.

name: Al-Waliyy
meaning: The Protecting Friend of the believers.

name: Al-Hamid
meaning: The Praiseworthy One worthy of all praise.

name: Al-Muhsi
meaning: The One who knows the number of all things.

name: Al-Mubdi
meaning: The Originator who creates without precedent.

name: Al-Mu'id
meaning: The Restorer who will resurrect His creation.

name: Al-Muhyi
meaning: The Giver of Life.

name: Al-Mumit
meaning: The Creator of Death.

name: Al-Hayy
meaning: The Ever-Living One.

name: Al-Qayyum
meaning: The Self-Subsisting One who sustains existence.

name: Al-Wajid
meaning: The Finder from whom nothing is hidden.

name: Al-Majid
meaning: The Noble One whose generosity is abundant.

name: Al-Wahid
meaning: The One, unique in His essence and attributes.

name: As-Samad
meaning: The Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs.

name: Al-Qadir
meaning: The Capable One who can create as He wills.

name: Al-Muqtadir
meaning: The Dominant One who creates everything easily.

name: Al-Muqaddim
meaning: The One who brings forward whom He wills.

name: Al-Mu'akhkhir
meaning: The One who delays whom He wills.

name: Al-Awwal
meaning: The First, with no beginning.

name: Al-Akhir
meaning: The Last, with no end.

name: Az-Zahir
meaning: The Manifest One whose existence is evident.

name: Al-Batin
meaning: The Hidden One beyond imagination.

name: Al-Wali
meaning: The Governor who manages the universe.

name: Al-Muta'ali
meaning: The Most Exalted One.

name: Al-Barr
meaning: The Source of Goodness and kindness.

name: At-Tawwab
meaning: The Acceptor of Repentance.

name: Al-Muntaqim
meaning: The Avenger who punishes the tyrants.

name: Al-Afuww
meaning: The Pardoner who loves to forgive.

name: Ar-Ra'uf
meaning: The Most Kind and Compassionate.

name: Malik-ul Mulk
meaning: The Owner of All Sovereignty.

name: Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram
meaning: The Lord of Majesty and Generosity.

name: Al-Muqsit
meaning: The Equitable One who acts justly.

name: Al-Jami
meaning: The Gatherer of all creatures on Judgment Day.

name: Al-Ghaniyy
meaning: The Self-Sufficient One.

name: Al-Mughni
meaning: The One who enriches and satisfies needs.

name: Al-Mani
meaning: The Withholder who prevents harm.

name: Ad-Darr
meaning: The Creator of the harmful.

name: An-Nafi
meaning: The Creator of the beneficial.

name: An-Nur
meaning: The Light who illuminates the worlds.

name: Al-Hadi
meaning: The Guide who gives guidance.

name: Al-Badi
meaning: The Originator of incomparable beauty.

name: Al-Baki
meaning: The Everlasting One.

name: Al-Warith
meaning: The Ultimate Inheritor of everything.

name: Ar-Rashid
meaning: The Guide to the Right Path.

name: As-Sabur
meaning: The Patient One who does not rush to punish.
